items.title: Mbeumo scores in encouraging Man Utd draw with PSG but Mount injured
items.description: Bryan Mbeumo earned Man Utd a 1-1 draw with Paris St-Germain in Gothenburg but Mason Mount's injury was a cause for concern.

items.title: Huang holds narrow lead over Hull at PIF London Championship
items.description: Anna Huang maintained her narrow lead over Charley Hull in the third round of the PIF London Championship.

items.title: Moore helps GB and Ireland to Shergar Cup crown
items.description: Ryan Moore bagged a Shergar Cup double on his return to the competition following a 20-year absence to help his Great Britain and Ireland team win the team event while he was also crowned leading rider over the six races.

items.title: McKenna vs Etinosa Oliha LIVE! World title clash in Dublin
Phillips hits winner against St Johnstone as St Mirren go top
items.description: Killian Phillips was on target again to keep St Mirren on top of the Premiership for a second Saturday night.

items.title: Bevan dazzles as Dundee crush sorry Aberdeen
items.description: Joe Bevan tormented Aberdeen as Dundee got their first Premiership points on the board with a deserved 2-0 victory at Dens Park.

items.title: Garcia hopes long-term friend Alonso's Chelsea finish second to Liverpool
items.description: As two Liverpool legends meet in pre-season, Luis Garcia says he hopes Xabi Alonso's Chelsea finish behind their former club in the Premier League.

items.title: FREE STREAM: McKenna vs Oliha undercard LIVE!
Huddersfield beat Catalans for third straight Super League win
items.description: Sam Halsall and Connor Wrench both went over for doubles as Huddersfield beat Catalans Dragons 42-20 for their third successive Super League win.

items.title: Messi's father Jorge dies aged 68 after illness
items.description: Lionel Messi's father and agent Jorge dies at the age of 68 following a long illness.

items.title: Huddersfield Giants to leave home for Dewsbury amid major investment
items.description: Betfred Super League side Huddersfield Giants have announced they are to leave the town and move to Dewsbury for the 2027 season onwards.

items.title: Nicholls pays tribute as Big Buck's dies aged 23
items.description: Big Buck’s, one of the greatest staying hurdlers of all time, has died at the age of 23.
